protocol.scope: first-party CPU queue; within-episode online adaptation; not a blind general agent benchmark
notes: The hidden schedule is generated before execution with paired seeds and is never supplied to planners or engines.
Success/risk safety scores and all-processed model calibration are reported separately.
Safety is a robust public-bound check, not a certificate derived from experience.
Current PreAct keeps static world proposals. Reactive is the explicitly ungated experimental control.
No-adaptation retains experience but freezes the service prior. No-memory stores authoritative ledger history but disables retrieval.
Transfer is a separately declared changed configuration, evaluated after development without parameter tuning.
